_comment: THE RATCHET. Read scripts/watch-silently-dead-crons.mjs beside this file.
WHY IT EXISTS, from a count rather than a principle. Between 2026-09-15 and
2026-09-17 the dead-cron watch was widened three times — paginated from 100
to 150 workflows, then split so a never-fired cron stopped being filed as
'not judged', then pointed at four repos instead of one. Each widening found
more. Zero were fixed. The first cross-repo run found four dead crons and one
never-fired cron, so the watch now exits 1 every single day.
That is the failure mode its own header warns about: 'a watch that cries wolf
is how odds-backfill.yml went fifteen days unnoticed in the first place'. A
workflow red every morning becomes furniture within a week, which is exactly
the state docs/declared-detectors.json exists to prevent — and the watch had
walked into it itself.
SO: green means NO NEW DECAY, not 'nothing is broken'. The entries below are
known rot, each with the date it was first seen and what would unblock it.
A key not in this file fails the run. A key here that is no longer dead makes
the run print 'baseline is stale, remove it' — and stay green, so fixing
something is never punished.
THIS FILE IS NOT declared-detectors.json. That one says 'red IS this
workflow's output, it is working'. This one says 'this is broken, nobody has
fixed it yet, and here is the date we admitted that'. Never move an entry
between the two files to quiet a run.
review_by IS THE PART THAT STOPS THIS BECOMING THE NEW FURNITURE. Past that
date the entry fails the run by name. Deferring is allowed; deferring
silently is not — moving the date means writing a new reason beside it.
KEYS are owner/repo:.github/workflows/x.yml. deploy.yml exists in all four
repos, so an unqualified key would let one repo's admission cover another's.
kind: 'dead'        failing its last DEAD_CRON_STREAK completed scheduled runs
kind: 'never_fired' declares a cron and has never produced a run, past its grace

measured.by: silently-dead-crons run 35237724585, the first across four repos

jeffunglesbee-create/jubilant-bassoon:.g.note: Also has not produced ANY scheduled run since 2026-07-31 — failing AND stopped firing, 48 days. The two facts may have one cause or two; neither has been read.
jeffunglesbee-create/jubilant-bassoon:.g.unblocked_by: read the run log for jubilant-bassoon run 30618071472 and establish why it stopped firing

jeffunglesbee-create/field-playground:.g.note: Three consecutive scheduled failures, 09-15 through 09-17. The newest rot of the four, and the most likely to have a recent cause.

jeffunglesbee-create/jubilant-bassoon:.g.note: Declares cron '0 8 * * 1' and has never produced a scheduled run in 86.7 days. Twelve Mondays. GitHub disables schedules in inactive repos and silently drops ones it cannot parse; jubilant-bassoon is active, so the parse is the candidate — UNVERIFIED.
jeffunglesbee-create/jubilant-bassoon:.g.unblocked_by: check the workflow's schedule block parses, and whether GitHub lists it as disabled
